Head_and_Face: Head with large widely separated compound eyes and three ocelli.
Body_and_Plumage: Slender delicate body measuring 25-50 mm, smaller than dragonfly.
Iridescent integument in blue, green, red, or metallic tones.
Two pairs of membranous wings with intricate venation folded together over abdomen at rest.
Narrow oblique thorax.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Extremely elongate thread-like abdomen comprising 10 segments.
Six slender weak legs adapted for perching.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (three tagmata).

Head_and_Face: Clubbed antennae with distinct terminal swelling.
Body_and_Plumage: Nymphalid butterfly with wingspan 50-75 mm.
Wings predominantly black or dark brown with striking white bands and orange-red patches.
Bright iridescent coloration with white spots along wing margins.
Ventral wing surface cryptically patterned in brown and gray.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Robust densely hairy body.
Reduced legs with forelegs brush-like and non-functional for walking.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body plan.

Body_and_Plumage: Satyrid butterfly with wingspan 30-50 mm.
Wings uniformly brown to dark brown with small eyespots (ocelli) arranged in rows.
Wings held closed at rest revealing cryptic ventral patterning.
Brown body integument matching wing coloration.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Slender hairy body.
Reduced brush-like forelegs characteristic of nymphalids.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (three tagmata).

Body_and_Plumage: Large danaid butterfly with wingspan 85-120 mm.
Wings vivid orange with prominent black venation and broad black borders containing two rows of white spots.
Black body with white speckling.
Ventral surface lighter orange with similar patterning.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Reduced black legs with brush-like forelegs.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body plan.

Body_and_Plumage: Pierid butterfly with wingspan 40-60 mm.
Wings predominantly white with black apical spots on forewings; females display additional black spots.
Wings held vertically above body at rest.
Ventral surface of hindwings pale yellow-green in summer form.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Slender white-hairy body.
Pale reduced legs with brush-like forelegs.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (three tagmata).

Body_and_Plumage: Pierid butterfly with wingspan 35-65 mm.
Wings uniformly yellow to orange-yellow in males; females may display white or greenish morphs.
Wing margins bordered with darker pigmentation.
Wings held vertically at rest; ventral surface similar but slightly paler.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Slender body matching wing coloration.
Reduced legs with brush-like forelegs characteristic of pierids.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body plan.

Body_and_Plumage: Small lycaenid butterfly with wingspan 15-40 mm.
Wings variable in coloration including blue, orange, brown, or gray often with iridescent scales.
Many species exhibit metallic blue or copper sheen.
Wings often display eyespots or tails on hindwings.
Ventral surface cryptically patterned with complex markings.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Slender small body.
Reduced legs with brush-like forelegs.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (three tagmata).

Head_and_Face: No distinct head; pentaradial symmetry with five arms extending from central disk.
Body_and_Plumage: Body size ranging 5-40 cm diameter.
Aboral (upper) surface textured with calcareous ossicles, spines, and pedicellariae.
Coloration variable including orange, red, purple, blue, or brown.
Endoskeleton of calcareous plates.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Oral (lower) surface bears central mouth and ambulacral grooves containing tube feet arranged in rows along each arm.
Tube feet suction-cup tipped for locomotion and prey capture.

Head_and_Face: No distinct head; globular body enclosed in spiny test (shell) measuring 3-10 cm diameter.
Oral surface bears Aristotle's lantern (jaw apparatus) with five teeth.
Body_and_Plumage: Test composed of fused calcareous plates forming rigid spherical structure.
Body covered with numerous movable spines varying in length.
Coloration purple, black, green, red, or brown.
Tube feet emerge between spine bases.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Spines articulate with tubercles on test surface.
Aboral surface contains anus.

Head_and_Face: Oral end surrounded by 10-30 branched tentacles (modified tube feet) used for feeding.
Body_and_Plumage: Flexible elongated sausage-shaped body measuring 10-30 cm.
Leathery thick body wall containing microscopic calcareous ossicles.
Coloration brown, black, red, or green.
Dorsal surface bears wart-like papillae.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Ventral surface has three rows of tube feet for locomotion.
Anus at aboral end.
Body cylindrical with dorsal-ventral differentiation.
